scrolling_world_map_note: Record byte 3 is the vertical scroll limit, 15 or 30; maps contain two or three vertically stacked 16x15 pages

combat_y3_path.condition: $05CD is neither $00 nor $FF, so the loader starts at record offset 3
combat_y3_path.renderer: $A15B calls $A06B for 15 rows; each map code indexes four tile bytes and a palette byte, expands to 2x2 background tiles, and packs 2-bit palettes into nametable attributes
combat_y3_path.composition_table_storage: offset-6 pointer through offset-4 map pointer (exclusive)
combat_y3_path.palette_packet_loader: $A700 reads address-low, length, then payload and stages a PPU $3Fxx update
